hooks.command: UA_DIR=.understand-anything; [ -d "$UA_DIR" ] || UA_DIR=.ua; USER_CFG="$HOME/.understand-anything/config.json"; node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const on=p=>{try{const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));return c!==null&&typeof c==="object"&&c.autoUpdate===true}catch{return false}};const rp=p=>{try{return fs.realpathSync(p)}catch{return require("path").resolve(p)}};const [u,p]=process.argv.slice(1);process.exit(rp(u)!==rp(p)&&on(u)&&on(p)?0:1)' "$USER_CFG" "$UA_DIR/config.json" 2>/dev/null && [ -f "$UA_DIR/meta.json" ] && [ -f "$UA_DIR/knowledge-graph.json" ] && [ "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$UA_DIR/meta.json','utf8')).gitCommitHash" 2>/dev/null)" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo "[understand-anything] The knowledge graph appears stale (meta.json commit differs from HEAD) and auto-update is enabled in both the user and project config. Ask the user whether they want to update it by re-running /understand (incremental update). Only if the user agrees, follow the procedure in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md. Do not start the update on your own." || true
